# AutoMSP

> AI automation platform for ServiceNow Managed Service Providers (MSPs). AutoMSP delivers AI-powered ticket triage, intelligent workflows, and SLA compliance to reduce SLA breaches and manual effort.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of AutoMSP's AI automation for ServiceNow MSPs.
- [Solutions](/solutions): All AutoMSP solutions for MSPs.
- [AI Ticket Triage](/solutions/ai-triage): Automated categorization, prioritization, and routing.
- [Intelligent Workflows](/solutions/intelligent-workflows): Self-healing automation for ServiceNow.
- [SLA Compliance](/solutions/compliance-sla): Real-time SLA tracking and breach prevention.
- [Why AutoMSP](/why-automsp): How AutoMSP compares to native ServiceNow and consulting.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Standard, Professional, and Enterprise plans.
- [Resources](/resources): Blog, case studies, whitepapers, and webinars.
- [About](/about): Mission, values, and team.
- [Careers](/careers): Open roles at AutoMSP.
- [Contact](/contact): Talk to sales or request a demo.
- [Support](/support): Knowledge base and FAQs.
